scope: Local-only original artifact validation and read-only PE inspection. No downloads, Windows calls, CI requests, compiled program execution or Git writes.

allMemberLedger.selfEntry: Excluded by original producer; its exact bytes are covered by original ZIP and report mapping.

originalResult.purpose: Modern formal MSVC build evidence and portable test executables, not a product installer or runtime certification.
originalResult.test_working_directories: Package paths in executables.json; choose an isolated controlled root.
limitations: Static CRT does not prove OS API compatibility.
Already terminated/cancelled hosted jobs may prevent always-upload.
Doctests are not compiled into the collected no-run harness executables.
Actual Windows 7/10/11 and classroom-device runs require separate evidence.

originalCleanup.artifact_lifetime: Retained for always-upload; hosted VM disposal removes remaining local evidence.
originalCleanup.scope: Only this exact RunnerTemp run-id/attempt root; no user-machine cleanup or runtime tests.
